## Review checklist

- [ ] The change preserves explicit approval of the latest version and safe handling of uncertain publication results.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or the description explains why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private drafts, database dumps, or sensitive logs.
- [ ] Validation claims reflect checks actually run; limitations and skipped checks are stated.

<!-- Suspected vulnerabilities belong in the private process described in SECURITY.md, not in a public PR containing exploit details. -->
